label: A holder MOTION_3 held in no respect, from the unlosable first holder
description: 5eb16c61 supplies, under double negation, an f that presently actualizes some other x in r, is in act in r and could not lack its act in r. Suppose f were MOTION_3 held in some respect s. Then f is in act in s and, by the first lackability premise, could lack its act in s; by 6e2176cd it is in act as to being and could lack being; by the second lackability premise, since f is in act in r, it could lack its act in r, against the choice of f. So f is held in no respect, and the same f holds x. All on one Holding, one Lackability, one InAct and one esse. This is the passage (2') from the operative respect to every respect that docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md 10.5 records as unformulated. It does not use the esse instance f834ee65, the timed present-moment reading or any giving relation, so it neither duplicates nor depends on the connection plans of f834ee65 and f360bb6f. Each lackability premise is needed (controls parts 2 and 3) and the bundle is satisfiable with a holder (part 1). All premises stay open.
